articles.title: Trump Melts Down Over Fox Host’s Crushing Exit
articles.description: Evan Vucci / REUTERS President Donald Trump has entered the chat over the shock dismissal of Maria Bartiromo from his favorite network, Fox News. Bartiromo, 58, was fired from the conservative network on Thursday after she had informed the White House about Fox’s secret instructions to not promote Trump’s election conspiracies on the air, according to Status . The instructions related to Trump’s primetime address to the nation in July, in which he claimed that China had interfered in the 2020 presidential election. Read more at The Daily Beast.

articles.description: Leaving a job usually comes with a few formalities before you’re officially out the door. articles.title: Lego PlayStation Officially Announced
articles.description: A Lego set paying homage to the classic original PlayStation console was officially announced at the Sony State of Play , confirming rumors from earlier this year. The brief look at the upcoming set showed off the build, including clicky buttons and some tiny vignettes to classic PlayStation games. A post on the PlayStation Blog details the set. The 1,911-piece set is built to be almost a 1:1 scale to the original PlayStation. It includes a model PlayStation and controller, and will cost $180 when it releases on October 4. To pay homage to the PlayStation for its anniversary, the Lego PlayStation has lots of little details and homages, like tiny dioramas of Ape Escape and Gran Turismo.
